description.value: Artisan Bistro is a West Coast-inspired casual dining restaurant set inside Broadmead Village Shopping Centre in the Saanich area of Victoria, with a menu built around local ingredients spanning pasta, fish and chips, handcrafted cocktails, and a curated BC wine list. The espresso bar runs on locally roasted Fernwood Coffee beans, and a spacious outdoor patio accommodates 25–30 guests. The kitchen explicitly caters to vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free diets, and the restaurant is reachable via Uber Eats, SkipTheDishes, and DoorDash in addition to in-house takeout.

address.value: 350 – 777 Royal Oak Drive, Victoria, BC V8X 4V1
